about: Candiac is a South Shore city in Montérégie, on the St. Lawrence east of La Prairie toward the Champlain Bridge corridor. It is an affluent planned suburb with waterfront parks, tree-lined streets, and easy Exo train access into Montréal. The city’s compact footprint faces the river and the Seaway channel. About 23,000 people live in Candiac.
